title: Florida House, District 21
what_it_does: Represents District 21 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Decided in the Aug. 18, 2026 universal primary: only Democrats qualified (five candidates), so the primary was open to all voters and the winner takes the seat. Central Florida Public Media reported Jacquelyn 'Jackie' Randall won; The Alligator reported she led by 161 votes as of Aug. 19 (a margin that may have triggered a recount). Incumbent Democratic Rep. Yvonne Hayes Hinson is retiring.
verified_ballot_note: Central Florida Public Media's Aug. 18 live results: 'House District 21: Democrat Jacquelyn "Jackie" Randall won outright in a universal primary' (https://www.cfpublic.org/live-updates/live-updates-primary-election-day-in-central-florida); WCJB and the Alligator confirm five Democrats and no Republicans ran (https://www.alligator.org/article/2026/08/alachua-county-ballot-november). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Jacquelyn "Jackie" Randall
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Respiratory therapist and college professor; former mayor of Hawthorne
candidates.background: Former mayor of Hawthorne. Led/won the five-way Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic universal primary for the open HD 21 seat (southeast Alachua County and northwest Marion County), which decided the seat because no Republican qualified.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 universal Democratic primary; Alligator reported a 161-vote lead as of Aug. 19

insurance.summary: Randall's first listed campaign message in her 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey is lowering costs, and she says she will work to rein in rising insurance premiums and utility costs and oppose policies she describes as padding corporate profits at the expense of working families.
insurance.quote: Jacquelyn will fight to rein in rising insurance premiums, utility costs, and everyday expenses, and oppose policies that pad corporate profits at the expense of working families.
